findings.title: Boolean conversion of PublishReceipt may break logic
findings.body: The change replaces `receipt.accepted` with `bool(receipt)`, which evaluates the truthiness of the entire `PublishReceipt` object rather than checking its `accepted` attribute. If `PublishReceipt` has other truthy attributes, this could incorrectly return `True` for rejected receipts. Restore the explicit attribute check to preserve the intended behavior.

summary.problem: The change from `receipt.accepted` to `bool(receipt)` alters the logic in a way that may incorrectly evaluate rejected receipts as accepted.
summary.done_well: The refactor simplifies the expression while maintaining the same intent in the common case where `accepted` is the sole truthy attribute.
